```{r}
#| include: false
#| out.width: "100%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

fva_tidy_num <- fc_acc_num |>
  group_by(product, store, model) |>
  summarise(fva = mean(fva, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(fva_inv = 1 - fva) |>
  select(-fva) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = fva_inv) |>
  select(-c(store, product))

fva_tidy_emp <- fc_acc_emp |>
  group_by(product_code, site_code, model) |>
  summarise(fva = mean(fva, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(fva_inv = 1 - fva) |>
  select(-fva) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = fva_inv) |>
  select(-c(site_code, product_code))


op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(2, 1, 2, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))

nemenyi(fva_tidy_num, conf.level = 0.95, plottype = "vmcb", main = "Numerical")
nemenyi(fva_tidy_emp, conf.level = 0.95, plottype = "vmcb", main = "Empirical")

par(op)

pdf(file.path(project_path("writings/pom/figs"), "nemenyi_side_by_side.pdf"), width = 12, height = 3.5)



op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(2, 1, 2, 1))

nemenyi(fva_tidy_num, conf.level = 0.95, plottype = "vmcb", main = "Numerical")
nemenyi(fva_tidy_emp, conf.level = 0.95, plottype = "vmcb", main = "Empirical")

par(op)
dev.off()

```
